---
Suite
Test: no
---
!define TEST_SYSTEM {slim}
!define slim.port {0}
!define TARGET_PLATFORM {Win32}

# FitNesse waits only 10 seconds for a Slim server. The launchers here build their
# projects first, so that deadline can pass before the server listens - the run
# then breaks off with "Error connecting to SLiM server" and looks flaky.
!define slim.timeout {120}

# Port of the SlimVerify host that the proxy variants put behind themselves. The
# proxy itself gets its port from FitNesse, only the host needs a fixed one.
!define VERIFY_HOST_PORT {9101}

# A different port means a different COMMAND_PATTERN, and FitNesse groups pages by
# test system: on the same command line the page that shoots the host would share
# the process with ProxySuite and take it down.
!define VERIFY_DEATH_HOST_PORT {9102}

!1 !-SlimProxy-! equivalence suite

Proof that the proxy is invisible: the very same pages run once '''directly''' against the
!-SlimVerify-! host and once '''through the proxy''', and both runs have to produce the same
counters page by page.

Every variant brings its own servers up through its ''!-COMMAND_PATTERN-!'', so a run needs nothing
but a click on ''Suite''. The builds are part of that pattern, so a stale executable cannot fake a
result.

!contents -R3 -g -p -f -h
